name: Digital twin on a sensor stream
description: Stream sensor readings (the simulated heated tank; switch the source to MQTT or connect recorded data) into the twin runtime: an ensemble Kalman filter estimates level, temperature and hidden states (leak flow, heater efficiency) with uncertainty and raises alerts.

meta.title: Digital twin on a sensor stream
meta.prompt: Monitor a heated water tank in real time from its level and temperature sensors (a digital twin) and detect leaks.
